views.accessibility:
- main:
  - paragraph: SUBSCRIPTION WORKSPACE
  - heading "Subscriptions" [level=1]
  - navigation "Workflow screens":
    - button "List"
    - button "Detail"
    - button "Edit"
    - button "Timeline"
  - region "Subscription screen":
    - search "Search":
      - text: Search
      - searchbox "Search"
    - text: Status
    - combobox "Status":
      - option "All states" [selected]
      - option "future"
      - option "trialing"
      - option "active"
      - option "paused"
      - option "pending cancellation"
      - option "past due"
      - option "unpaid"
      - option "terminated"
    - text: Sort
    - combobox "Sort":
      - option "Name A–Z" [selected]
      - option "Name Z–A"
    - tablist "Archive views":
      - tab "Active"
      - tab "Archived" [selected]
    - tabpanel "Archived":
      - list "Records":
        - listitem:
          - 'group "Archived: Subscription 10"':
            - 'button "Subscription 10 Status: Trialing Jan 1, 2026, 12:00 AM $190.00 · yearly"':
              - text: Subscription 10 Trialing
              - time: Jan 1, 2026, 12:00 AM
              - text: $190.00 · yearly
            - text: Archived
    - navigation "Pagination":
      - text: 1 record Showing 1–1 of 1
      - button "Previous page" [disabled]: ‹
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - button "Page 1": "1"
      - button "Next page" [disabled]: ›
      - text: Page 1 of 1
  - status
